about: Every asset of SCION-36 (Bounded Biharmonic Weights) PAE-02. The dog and the person are whole public-domain archive frames, each one auto-triangulated, auto-rigged from its medial axis and skinned with bounded biharmonic weights (build/autorig.py, build/rigs.py, build/skin.py). Everything else is computed. No web images, no generated images, no drawing of the dog.

assets.name: dog views
assets.what: whole frames of a real dog, each used as ONE mesh with its own SAM edge, blur and grain
assets.operation: SAM polygon -> raster mask (largest component, holes filled) -> grid auto-triangulation (2 px) -> medial-axis handles (points: nose, tail tip; bones: neck, back, tail, legs) -> bounded biharmonic weights (active set) -> linear blend skinning per frame -> textured rasterisation; graded for dusk; one frame mirrored for the refusal

assets.name: person
assets.what: one frame of a woman at a door, seen from behind, kept as a contre-jour silhouette
assets.operation: cut from the white door by colour (the kit masks are the door, not her), auto-rigged with the same BBW code (head point, chest and hip bones, arm bone), darkened to a silhouette; no face is visible

assets.name: porch, wall, half door, window, post, room, light pool
assets.operation: synthesized in numpy by build/render.py from a pinhole camera (projection of a floor, a facade plane and a room); the light pool is the opening projected from a lamp point

assets.name: sound
assets.what: room tone, crickets, projector whir, formant-synth voice murmurs (no words), paws, latch, creak, hum, settle
